newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Santander Investment to open Colombian brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Santander Investment to open Colombian brokerage.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 15 Reuter - A spokesman for Santander Investment Colombia SA, a branch of Spain's Grupo Santander, said said it plans to open a brokerage in Colombia's northwest city of Medellin by mid-year.

The spokesman, who asked not to be identified by name, said Santander's place on the Medellin stock exchange, the country's largest, had already been purchased from Corredores Asociados, Colombia's top brokerage firm.

The new firm will be called Santander Valores. Grupo Santander previously announced plans to purchase a 55 percent stake in Bancoquia, Colombia's eight largest bank in terms of assets and financial arm of the Julio Mario Santo Domingo conglomerate.
